stories.summary: Enrolments in information technology degrees saw the sharpest decline of any major field last year, according to Education Department data. The drop follows years of growth spurred by projections of high demand for tech workers. Graduates are now finding full-time work harder to secure after finishing study.

stories.summary: Early childhood educators in South African communities used the Hopscotch Programme App to identify and address developmental motor delays. Researchers found the mHealth platform demonstrated above-average usability and helped teachers improve their instructional performance. The study evaluated the app through laboratory testing and practical classroom implementation.

stories.summary: Dhamaris Alarcón, a 16-year-old student, won a gold medal at the Latin American Astronomy and Astronautics Olympiad in Paraguay. This follows her silver-medal win in Brazil last year. The student is currently in her fifth year of secondary education at the Saco Oliveros school.

stories.title: Quebec universities report international student decline
stories.summary: International student numbers in Quebec universities fell by about 12 percent this fall, marking a second consecutive year of double-digit declines. Only Bishop's University reported an increase. The drop raises concerns regarding university finances, research, and academic programs as the government considers further reforms to the education system.

stories.title: Baylor University faces budget deficit
stories.summary: Baylor University is pausing hiring and delaying capital spending to address a $30 million deficit. The shortfall follows a dip in undergraduate enrollment at the Texas institution. The university is currently attempting to shore up the budget gap.

stories.title: Carrollton High School students nominated for honors
stories.summary: Fifteen students from Carrollton High School have been nominated to compete in the state-level Governor's Honors Program. The program will be held at Georgia Southern University starting in June. The students will now prepare for state evaluations in their respective subject areas.

The project, funded by the European Union, focuses on digital pedagogy and artificial intelligence. The training is held at the Ladipo Alayande School of Science to strengthen teacher digital competence.

stories.summary: The University of Victoria is navigating the integration of AI in academic writing, stating a commitment to ethical and transparent use. stories.summary: A University of Illinois report found that participation in dual credit and Advanced Placement courses increased following a 2021 state law. stories.title: India simplifies visa application process
stories.summary: The Indian Ministry of Home Affairs has reduced main visa categories from 13 to nine and cut application form fields by up to 70 percent. The government says the move aims to improve administrative efficiency and reduce the time required for foreign nationals to complete their applications.

stories.title: NHL TV providers say Rogers' Monday hockey move inflates prices
stories.summary: Cogeco, Eastlink and SaskTel accuse Rogers Communications of violating competition rules by moving Monday night hockey games exclusively to its Sportsnet Plus streaming service. The providers say the move forces fans to pay a monthly add-on fee to access games. The games are now behind a paywall.

stories.title: Pilot killed in plane crash during Quebec Remembrance Day event
stories.summary: A pilot in his 60s died in a plane crash during a Remembrance Day ceremony in Saint-Georges, Quebec. The pilot was alone in the aircraft when it went down in a wooded area near the local airport. The formation flight was part of the morning memorial event.

stories.title: Ronaldinho returns to professional football with Ravenna FC
stories.summary: Brazilian football legend Ronaldinho is returning to competitive action after more than a decade away. The 46-year-old has joined Italian Serie C side Ravenna FC as both a player and shareholder. He is scheduled to make his comeback appearance for the club on November 15.

stories.title: Uber driver convicted of raping Villanova student
stories.summary: A Montgomery County resident has been convicted of raping a Villanova University student. The 21-year-old victim had ordered an Uber back to her dorm after feeling sick from drinking. The incident occurred in Hovanian Hall in September 2024. Court documents confirmed the conviction following the ride.

stories.title: Early action on diabetes urged to prevent complications
stories.summary: Diabetes is increasingly affecting diverse age groups and income levels, according to health experts. The International Diabetes Federation and WHO are promoting early action to manage the condition before serious complications like heart attacks or strokes occur. The disease is often silent until damage is already present.

stories.title: Hoax bomb threats hit hundreds of schools
stories.summary: Hundreds of schools in Scotland, Northern Ireland and the Republic of Ireland were evacuated following a wave of hoax bomb threats on Wednesday. Police confirmed the warnings were bogus and similar to incidents reported last month. The threats were sent as a generic communication to the sites.

stories.title: India reduces visa categories for foreign nationals
stories.summary: The Indian government has reduced its main visa categories from 13 to nine and sub-categories from 49 to 23. The Ministry of Home Affairs implemented the changes in August 2026, citing a goal to simplify procedures. The system was previously rationalised in October 2025.

stories.title: Ness Wadia defends Punjab Kings' trade of Arshdeep Singh
stories.summary: Punjab Kings co-owner Ness Wadia described the decision to trade Arshdeep Singh for Hardik Pandya ahead of IPL 2027 as difficult but mutually beneficial. Wadia admitted that parting ways with the fast bowler after eight years was an emotional decision for the franchise. The trade is now confirmed.

stories.title: Three arrested following assault near Guelph street party
stories.summary: Three men have been arrested and face charges of assault causing bodily harm following an altercation at a commercial plaza in September. The incident occurred near an unsanctioned homecoming party in Guelph. One business window was smashed when a victim fell against it during the physical fight.

stories.title: Canada remains undefeated at women's hockey championship
stories.summary: Canada finished the group stage of the world women's hockey championship with a perfect record after beating Finland 2-0. Caitlin Kraemer and Sarah Fillier scored for Canada, while Ann-Renee Desbiens made 25 saves. Canada is scheduled to face Czechia in the quarterfinals on Friday.

stories.title: Government rationalises Indian visa regime
stories.summary: The Indian government has reduced its main visa categories from 13 to nine and sub-categories from 49 to 23. The Ministry of Home Affairs implemented the changes on August 27, 2026, to simplify procedures. The government stated it studied visa systems in developed countries to inform the update.

stories.title: Early detection remains critical for diabetes management
stories.summary: The International Diabetes Federation and WHO have designated the theme of early action for World Diabetes Day. Endocrinologists note that patients often discover the disease only after suffering a heart attack, stroke or retinal damage. The condition remains dangerous because it is frequently silent until complications arise.

stories.title: High court orders anti-bullying mechanisms for LGBTQIA+ students
stories.summary: The Punjab and Haryana High Court has ordered the school education department to ensure all schools establish internal mechanisms to address bullying. The mandate includes complaints regarding gender identity and sexual orientation. Schools have three months to implement the safety and mental health guidelines for all students.

stories.title: Police warn against post-exam Vuzu parties in Harare
stories.summary: The Zimbabwe Republic Police has issued a warning regarding planned Vuzu parties targeting students who recently completed national examinations. Authorities cautioned organisers and attendees that unlawful activities will face police action. The warning was published on X following reports of planned celebrations in the Waterfalls area.

stories.title: Decline in international students could cost UK economy billions
stories.summary: A report by London Economics suggests that a 30 percent drop in international business student enrolments could cost the UK economy 4.2 billion pounds. The decline follows the implementation of stricter immigration measures, including a visa ban for student dependents. The loss is equivalent to 32,300 jobs.

stories.title: Lairenlakpam Ambekar Meetei reaches Youth Olympics boxing final
stories.summary: Lairenlakpam Ambekar Meetei has reached the men's 50kg boxing final at the Dakar 2026 Youth Olympic Games. The Manipuri boxer defeated his Colombian opponent 5-0 to end India's 16-year wait for a finalist in the competition. He will now compete against Ireland's Kristian Jubani for the gold medal.

stories.title: Stellantis sale of Brampton plant sparks federal criticism
stories.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney called the planned sale of a Stellantis assembly plant in Brampton a betrayal of obligations to Canada. However, a 2022 funding agreement between the automaker and the federal government reportedly contained specific exceptions that allowed the company to close the site.

stories.title: WWII veteran credits laughter for reaching 100
stories.summary: John Watson, a Second World War veteran from Saskatchewan, has reached his 100th birthday. Watson, the last surviving member of the Royal Regina Rifles to have served overseas, attributed his longevity to maintaining a positive attitude. He joked that he fooled those who thought he would not return.

stories.title: The view from Edinburgh: sustainable recruitment starts with sustainable partnerships
stories.summary: Sustainable recruitment has become a frequent phrase in the UK international education strategy. Despite the term appearing in government and university conversations, there is no shared understanding of its meaning. Some define it by finances, others by enrolment numbers. The term remains flexible enough to mean anything.

stories.title: Centre simplifies visa norms for foreign nationals visiting India
stories.summary: The Ministry of Home Affairs has reduced main visa categories from 13 to 9 and sub-categories from 49 to 23. The government says the move aims to boost foreign tourist, medical, and student arrivals. The system is intended to be more responsive to the requirements of foreign nationals.

stories.title: India simplifies visa rules with categories cut and paperwork reduced
stories.summary: India has reduced its main visa categories from 13 to 9 and sub-categories from 49 to 23. The government also cut visa application form fields by 65 to 70 percent. The new system, which offers clearer purpose-based options, is expected to be fully implemented by the end of 2026.

stories.summary: Loudoun County Public Schools will offer 11th grade students the SAT at no cost during the school day this spring. stories.title: India cuts visa categories and reduces application form fields

stories.title: UK business schools report declining international enrolments
stories.summary: Seven in ten UK business schools reported lower international enrolments for the 2026/27 academic year. Half of those schools described the decline as significant. Six in ten schools expect January 2027 enrolments to be lower year-on-year, a figure five times higher than predictions made in last year's survey.

stories.title: Supreme Court rules on ancestral property rights
stories.summary: The Supreme Court has ruled that a grandson does not automatically acquire a birthright in property inherited by his father from his grandfather. The court clarified that once property is inherited, it may become separate property. Children cannot automatically claim a share in it during the father's lifetime.

stories.title: Joe Root refuses to comment on ball-tampering claims
stories.summary: Joe Root has declined to comment on Usman Khawaja's revelations regarding Australia's ball-tampering practices during the 2017-18 Ashes. stories.summary: Relative demand for on-campus study in the US rose 40% on November 8 compared to the previous week, according to Studyportals. CEO Edwin van Rest stated that students react quickly to political news. The increase follows two years of declining interest in American universities.

stories.summary: The Agriculture, Nutrition and Health Academy is accepting applications for three one-year fellowships in Sub-Saharan Africa and South Asia. The programme aims to use recent research to guide policy decisions toward healthy diets. Applications for the 2027 round close on February 28, 2027.

stories.summary: The Council for the Indian School Certificate Examinations will hold Class 10 English exams between February and March 2026. The board has released the paper structure and marking scheme on its official website to assist students in preparing for the upcoming theory and practical components.

stories.title: VSU students teach generative AI to retirees
stories.summary: Valdosta State University students hosted a class to explain generative AI to older adults. The participants, who grew up without everyday access to computers or the internet, learned about the technology and its ethical uses. The students noted the topic often exceeded their own personal expertise.

stories.title: Mustafizur Rahman to enter IPL 2027 auction
stories.summary: Bangladesh fast bowler Mustafizur Rahman will register for the IPL 2027 mini-auction. The Bangladesh Cricket Board confirmed the development following the player's release from the Kolkata Knight Riders last season. Rahman is seeking a new franchise contract after a controversial exit from his previous team.

stories.title: India faces Afghanistan in U19 Asia Cup semifinal
stories.summary: India will play Afghanistan in the U19 Asia Cup semifinal following a group stage performance marked by two wins and one defeat. While Aaryavir Sehwag provides a prolific batting presence, the team faces a challenge from the Afghan pace attack. A spot in the final is available.

stories.summary: Chief Minister A Revanth Reddy has directed officials to transition Telangana to a 10+2 education pattern starting in the 2027-28 academic year. The reform aims to move Classes 11 and 12 into the school framework, effectively replacing the current system of junior colleges.

stories.summary: The government has selected 13,092 schools for the PM SHRI scheme, reaching 90 percent of its target. The initiative, which has a total outlay of 27,360 crore rupees, aims to develop exemplar institutions aligned with the National Education Policy 2020 through a three-stage challenge mode.

stories.title: Odisha allocates 393 crore rupees for college Wi-Fi
stories.summary: The Odisha government approved a 393.62 crore rupee initiative to provide free high-speed internet to 601 government and aided colleges. The scheme, titled Odisha Shiksha Setu, will be implemented over three years. The first phase will cover 130 institutions starting in the 2026-27 financial year.

stories.title: Harvard Kennedy School offers public service fellowships
stories.summary: Harvard Kennedy School is accepting applications for the 2027 American Service Fellowship. The programme provides a full scholarship and a partial living stipend for US public servants to enroll in the one-year Mid-Career Master in Public Administration. The deadline for applications is December 1, 2026.

stories.title: Educators gather for AI summit on student success
stories.summary: More than 90 educators attended Kent ISD's fourth annual AI Summit to discuss technology in the classroom. The event focused on using tools like Gemini to simplify teacher workloads and increase accessibility. The goal remains to use AI to amplify student voices and expand equitable access.

stories.title: Parent withdraws deposit for AI-led school
stories.summary: A tech executive who toured an Alpha School in Orange County pulled her deposit, describing the environment as cold and sterile. While she stated she is not anti-AI, she expressed dissatisfaction with the specific execution of the school's AI-led educational model.

stories.title: Fiji faces teacher shortages in remote areas
stories.summary: Minister for Education Aseri Radrodro identified teacher shortages and a reluctance to serve in remote communities as primary challenges for Fiji's education sector. The ministry is currently working to strengthen the delivery of education through the new Online Teacher Registration Project.

stories.title: Ghana integrates AI and coding into school curriculum
stories.summary: Ghana is introducing AI and coding into its education system. The initiative aims to modernize the curriculum, though questions remain regarding the readiness of teachers and classrooms to support these new subjects. The full piece is for subscribers.

stories.title: Murali Kartik defends Gautam Gambhir against criticism
stories.summary: Former spinner Murali Kartik stated that India head coach Gautam Gambhir has the thick skin required to ignore social media criticism. Gambhir has faced scrutiny following inconsistent Test performances and mixed results in bilateral assignments since taking the role in July 2024.

stories.title: UIIC declares AO preliminary exam results
stories.summary: United India Insurance Company Limited has shortlisted 5,806 candidates for the Administrative Officer Mains examination following the release of preliminary results. The Tier-II exam is scheduled for November 30, 2026. The recruitment process aims to fill 225 vacancies.

stories.title: BCCI rules out immediate IPL expansion
stories.summary: BCCI secretary Devajit Saikia has ruled out expanding the IPL to 12 teams, stating the idea has not been discussed formally or informally. The board is currently focused on the 20th edition of the tournament, which is scheduled to take place in March 2027.

stories.title: India advances to SAFF Championship semifinals
stories.summary: India secured a spot in the SAFF Championship semifinals after a 1-0 victory over the Maldives. Suhail Ahmad Bhat scored the winning penalty, while goalkeeper Priyansh Dubey made late saves to preserve the lead. India finished the group stage with two wins.
